title: Integral geometric fibres commute with finite coefficient extension
statement: In the setting of [lem-pod-lisse-integral-scalar-fiber-map], its canonical O_L-linear map O_L tensor_O_E F_y → (i_*F)_y is an isomorphism.

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp. 146-147; finite-level scalar stalk comparison; adic reconstruction as in Stacks Tag 09B8

proof.text: The source fibre is finite; ordinary scalar extension of a finite module is finite, and uniqueness of left adjoints transfers this fact to ringExtendScalars. Thus W=O_L tensor_O_E F_y is finite over O_L.
Finite O_L modules are complete and Hausdorff for the uniformizer ideal, by the stated finite-module adic completeness result.
For each n the comparison followed by projection is surjective with kernel J^(n+1)W. Its quotient-kernel equivalence identifies W/J^(n+1)W with D_n.

The inverse quotient maps form a compatible family of maps lim D→W/J^(n+1)W. IsAdicComplete.StrictMono.lift for the cofinal sequence n+1 gives an inverse map lim D→W. Its reduction formula proves surjectivity by limit extensionality. Hausdorffness and the projection kernel formulas prove injectivity.
